messages:
maya: Heads-up — 2h change window tonight 06:00–08:00 UTC. Legal just asked for an embargo extension on the public release notes until the export feature gets a quick compliance sign-off. Need SLO readout + pin/rollback decision plan. cc @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: Scheduled window booked: 06:00-08:00 UTC. Canary target: v3.15.0-rc. To pin a version react with :pushpin: or run `deploy-bot pin <version>`.

sam: Can we start canary at 10% traffic and warm for 15m? smoke tests pass locally.

ryan: Quick SLO snapshot (last 24h): p95 latency 90ms, error rate 0.05%, embed-queue avg 120ms. No infra alerts. I'm OK to proceed with 10% canary.

alice: Legal: they want embargo until 09:00 UTC unless we remove the experimental export flag. If we keep it, they want telemetry capture (consent bits). That could block public notes.

maya: Plan proposal — start canary 10% at 06:00, wait 15m. Abort if errors >1% or p95 >200ms. If no sign-off by 07:30, pin back to v3.14.1 and stop rollout. Ops will have rollback playbook ready.

ops-liz: I'll watch logs/dashboards. Set alert: embed-queue > 5s, errors > 0.8% during rollout. Rollback scripts are staged at `/opt/deploy/tools/rollback.sh`.

sean: Release notes draft is ready but embargoed sections are redacted. Will hold final publish until legal clears.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 06:00 UTC. Instances: 8/8 healthy, canary traffic: 10% (eu-west-1, us-east-1). Smoke checks: pass.

sam: Observing a lag spike on embed-queue at 06:07 (+30s). :eyes:

ops-liz: Investigating — looks like worker pool exhausted due to a smaller-than-expected batch window. Increased worker pool from 4->8 and bumped batch size to 64; queue lag dropped. Adding this to postmortem notes.

ryan: Metrics stabilized at 06:22. p95 now ~120ms, errors 0.12%. Still within thresholds.

maya: Legal offered provisional sign-off for export if we enable telemetry capture and retention for 72h. Given the telemetry mitigation, decision: ramp to 50% at 07:00 UTC. Keep embargo on public notes until ops confirms support playbook is posted.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 50% at 07:00 UTC. Canary version: v3.15.0-rc -> traffic 50%. Pin recommendation: `v3.15.0-rc` flagged as release candidate.

sean: Updating release notes: added telemetry link and experimental flag instructions for support. Not publishing yet (embargoed).

maya: Quick final check — any objections to continue ramp and hold public release until 08:30? :thumbsup:

alice: +1 from legal, but request embargo hold until 08:30 to give support a buffer.

maya: Agreed. Public release scheduled for 08:30 UTC unless we hit thresholds. Rollback plan if needed: run deploy-bot rollback to `v3.14.1` or pin via `deploy-bot pin v3.14.1`. Example rollback command: ```
# rollback to last stable
deploy-bot rollback --version v3.14.1 --force --reason "emergency"
```

ops-liz: Standby and monitoring. I'll post a short ops playbook in the release channel (runbook + links) once final checks done.

sean: Holding public notes. When legal lifts embargo, I'll publish and ping marketing.

maya: Thanks team — will post a short postmortem w/ the embed-queue fix and telemetry follow-up. Keeping this thread as the change-window record.
